#### Check out the bundle deals and weekly discounts for July!

#### Fallout 1st – July

Fallout 1st members can get their own exclusive prime mover generator for free from July 7th to August 4th. You can find out more about becoming a Fallout 1st member here.

#### FREE Plush Toy – July

Every month you can pick up a free new Axolotl plush toy from the Atomic Shop that matches the Axolotl you can catch in-game that month!

Starting July 7th, grab the Scaly Axolotl while fishing in specific locations and its plushie version for free in the Atomic Shop!
